In [[18 BBY/Legends|18 BBY]] after the [[ambush near the Twins]], [[Thi Xon Yimmon]], [[Cerean/Legends|Cerean]] leader of the [[Whiplash]] resistance, was captured by the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]]; Vader later jailed Yimmon in the [[Kantaros Station]] guarded by a [[Inquisitorius/Legends|Inquisitorius]] contingent commanded by [[Probus Tesla]].
However the news of the location of the prison soon arrived to the ears of the criminal underground and later to the various resistance fighters; two escape's plan were putted in act, one by the [[Whiplash]] members [[Den Dhur]] and [[I-5YQ]], followed by the [[Antarian Rangers/Legends|Antarian Ranger]] [[Sacha Swiftbird]], who posed as [[Black Sun/Legends|Black Sun]] members, the other by the [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]] [[Jax Pavan]].
In the fighting Sacha killed Probus, saving Pavan, and Pavan himself [[Lightsaber duel/Legends|dueled]] with Darth Vader but in the end Yimmon was freed, and all the resistance fighters escaped from the [[Space station/Legends|space station]].
